{{Quote|I've spoilt their main prize and our bonus presents are waiting in the wings. Give the word and we can start the ''celebration''.|Zatch, to [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
'''Zatch''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in the employ of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]. He was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] with red skin.
